question: For what does Paul say he gives thanks?
choices: Their growing faith and increasing love
explanation: Paul thanks God because their faith grows exceedingly and the love of every one of them abounds.

question: What does Paul boast about when he speaks of the Thessalonians among the churches of God?
choices: Their patience and faith in persecutions and tribulations
explanation: Paul boasts in their patience and faith through persecution and tribulation.

question: With whom will the Lord Jesus be revealed from heaven?
explanation: Paul says Jesus will be revealed from heaven with His mighty angels.

question: What will happen to those who do not obey the gospel?
choices: They will be punished with everlasting destruction
explanation: Paul says they will be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord.

question: When Christ comes, He will be glorified in whom?
choices: In the rulers of the earth
explanation: Paul says Christ will be glorified in His saints and admired in all them that believe.

question: What did Paul tell the Thessalonians not to be shaken into thinking was at hand?
explanation: Paul told them not to be shaken or troubled as though the day of Christ were at hand.

question: What must come first before that day?
explanation: Paul says there must first come a falling away.

question: What title does Paul give to the coming opponent?
explanation: Paul calls him the man of sin, the son of perdition.

question: How will the Lord consume the Wicked?
choices: With the spirit of His mouth
By the preaching of the church
explanation: The Lord will consume him with the spirit of His mouth and destroy him with the brightness of His coming.

question: To what are believers told to hold fast?
choices: The traditions they had been taught
explanation: Paul tells them to stand fast and hold the traditions they had been taught.

question: For what does Paul ask the Thessalonians to pray?
choices: That the word of the Lord may have free course and be glorified
That the church would gain influence
explanation: Paul asks prayer that the word of the Lord would spread quickly and be glorified.

question: What does Paul say the Lord will do for believers?
choices: Stablish them and keep them from evil
explanation: Paul says the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish and keep them from evil.

question: What rule does Paul repeat?
choices: If any will not work, neither should he eat
He that preaches should live by the gospel
The laborer is worthy of his hire
explanation: Paul says if anyone will not work, neither should he eat.

question: How are believers told to treat someone who disobeys the apostolic instruction?
explanation: They are not to count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

question: What does Paul pray the Lord of peace will give?
explanation: Paul prays that the Lord of peace Himself will give them peace always by all means.

question: From where will the Lord Jesus be revealed?
explanation: The Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels.

question: What does Paul say groweth exceedingly in them?
explanation: Your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth.

question: In what will the Lord take vengeance?
explanation: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God.

question: What is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God?
explanation: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God.

question: Who shall have rest with Paul and his companions?
explanation: And to you who are troubled rest with us.

question: From what will the punished be cut off?
explanation: Punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power.

question: What does Paul pray God would count them worthy of?
explanation: We pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling.

question: Why will Christ be admired in all them that believe?
explanation: To be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

question: To whom is it a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation?
explanation: It is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you.

question: Whose name does Paul pray may be glorified in them?
explanation: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him.

question: Paul prays God would fulfil the good pleasure of his goodness and the work of what?
explanation: Fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power.

question: For what are they said to suffer?
explanation: That ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer.

question: Who sends this letter to the church of the Thessalonians?
explanation: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians.

question: What else is the man of sin called?
explanation: That man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition.

question: Where does he sit, showing himself that he is God?
explanation: He as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

question: Whose working is his coming after?
explanation: His coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders.

question: Who has chosen the Thessalonians to salvation from the beginning?
explanation: God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation.

question: By what does Paul beseech them?
choices: By the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ
explanation: We beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him.

question: Not to be shaken by spirit, word, or what, as from Paul?
explanation: Neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.

question: What does the man of sin exalt himself above?
choices: All that is called God or worshipped
explanation: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped.

question: What does Paul say already works?
explanation: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work.

question: How will the Lord destroy the Wicked?
choices: With the brightness of his coming
explanation: Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming.

question: His coming is after the working of Satan with power, signs and what?
explanation: With all power and signs and lying wonders.

question: Why do those who perish perish?
choices: They received not the love of the truth
explanation: Because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

question: What will God send those who believe a lie?
explanation: God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie.

question: Through what has God chosen them to salvation?
choices: Sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth
explanation: God hath chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth.

question: When had Paul told them these things?
choices: When he was yet with them
explanation: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

question: What does Paul say they know?
choices: What withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time
explanation: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

question: Until what will he who now letteth let?
choices: He be taken out of the way
explanation: He who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.

question: That they might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in what?
explanation: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

question: By what did God call them to the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ?
explanation: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

question: How were they taught the traditions they should hold?
choices: By word or by Paul’s epistle
explanation: Hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

question: What has God given through grace, along with good hope?
explanation: God, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace.

question: In what does Paul pray they be stablished?
explanation: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

question: Whom does Paul say are brethren beloved of the Lord, bound to be thanked for?
explanation: We are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord.

question: What does Paul wish to be with them all at the end?
choices: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
explanation: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

question: When did Paul and his companions labour so as not to burden them?
explanation: Wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you.

question: In what are they told not to be weary?
explanation: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

question: From whom are they told to withdraw?
explanation: Withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly.

question: Paul asks to be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men, for all men have not what?
explanation: That we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

question: In whom does Paul have confidence concerning them?
explanation: We have confidence in the Lord touching you.

question: Into what does Paul pray the Lord direct their hearts?
choices: The love of God and the patient waiting for Christ
explanation: The Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

question: In whose name does Paul command them to withdraw?
explanation: We command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

question: What did Paul and his companions not eat for nought?
explanation: Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought.

question: Why did Paul work, though he had power not to?
choices: To make themselves an ensample to follow
To earn his keep in prison
explanation: To make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

question: What does Paul say some among them are, working not at all?
explanation: Working not at all, but are busybodies.

question: How are those who do not work to work and eat their own bread?
explanation: With quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

question: Why should they have no company with the one who obeys not?
explanation: Note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

question: Where is the word of the Lord already glorified?
explanation: That the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you.

question: What is the token in every epistle of Paul?
choices: The salutation with his own hand
explanation: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle.

question: When did Paul first command them that he who will not work should not eat?
explanation: Even when we were with you, this we commanded you.

question: A disorderly brother does not walk after what?
choices: The tradition he received of Paul
explanation: Walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

question: What did Paul say they know?
choices: How they ought to follow Paul and his companions
explanation: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us.

question: Paul says they worked not because they lacked what?
explanation: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample.

question: What does Paul expect they both do and will do?
explanation: That ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

question: How did Paul say he behaved among them?
explanation: For we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you.

question: From whom does Paul ask to be delivered?
explanation: That we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men.
